name: due-process-complaint
description: The Due Process Complaint Writer: a free plugin for Claude and ChatGPT that writes special education due process complaints (IDEA) from a child's IEP, school documents and other important information, with every fact checked against them.

plugins.name: due-process-complaint
plugins.description: Writes a special education due process complaint (IDEA) from a child's IEP, school documents and other important information — evaluations, prior written notices, progress reports, service logs, emails, private evaluations and the family's own account — for any US state, in Claude, ChatGPT or any other app that reads plugins and skills: facts confirmed with the person filing, every claim the record supports argued against the district's own stated reasons, the law researched for the filing state and circuit, the state's filing details confirmed on its official filing page, every date, figure, quotation and citation checked, the arithmetic shown and confirmed, anything unverified flagged for the person signing, delivered as a Word document to edit, sign and file, with a PDF on request.
